BiblicalUsage: In the New Testament, gynaikeîos is the word for wife. In 1 Peter 3:7, the text says "giving honour unto the wife."
TheologicalSignificance: For me, gynaikeîos means wife, nothing more and nothing less.
RelatedTopics: Word of God; Faith; Christian Life
